name: explain_fact
description: Explain WHY the current fact is what it is for (tenant_id, subject, predicate): current resolution (value, status, policy_version, reason, validity window), the winning source + authority, supporting and CONTRARY evidence references, assessments, superseded/rejected/disputed prior assertions, and the outcome history. Optimized for agent consumption. tenant_id is the requested data scope (authorization handled by the Gateway governance layer).

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose data this operation is scoped to (requested data scope). The Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it.

subject.description: The subject/entity key the fact is about.
